membershipEvidence.notes: Whole Litoral Penitentiary as independent roofed buildings within its twelve pavilion compounds and intrinsic service/perimeter structures. Compound boundaries and yards must remain open. One pavilion block does not complete the prison; nearby separate prisons are excluded. Approximate2023ensemble using original current/later numerical outlines; unobserved presence/date/height and exterior estimates remain explicit. All12pavilion settings and intrinsic service/perimeter/roof groups retained, with open yards preserved. All retained owned source outlines accounted for. Three latest machine-inferred bodies have5.5m nominal original height estimates with5m height allowance; no measured/presence/date assertion. Generalized boundaries and source-date continuity remain uncertain; every appearance image unused.
